purpose: Existing-data PC completion; no new device run or default promotion
selection_before_fit: One workload-response lag, retaining frozen beta/state increments and pre-load reference. Test whether delayed registered load improves response shape without fitting ambient or gain.
initial_h_meaning: No new registered work yet; does not assert absent hidden heat from preparation
range_meaning: Prespecified diagnostic search interval, not a physical identification bound
loss: mean squared AP error on existing post-load comparison samples
evaluation: Other complete sessions held out from primary parameter fit, but all previously seen; posthoc evaluation only
stability: leave one whole session out, equal weight per training session; not independent validation
exclusions: long-regimen data without matching preload procedure
C/L lacking published complete candidate comparison window; preserved as energy controls
energy: No fit. One saved queue/seed201/realized1.5 schedule per CPU_URGENT/B2/B3. Frozen state-W arithmetic is unsupported-transition sensitivity, not validated policy energy.
stress: Common whole-window additive background cancels algebraically. Independent idle residual stress uses finite observed late-common residual extrema separately per APK protocol; no confidence bound or correction.
